name: sense_cone_enter
about: A hostile Troika human (player_reaction D_HT 5, npc_perception 3 -> Inspection_Vision_Distances[3] = 440 units, vdata/system/feats.txt; m_flFieldOfView 0.2, CAI_BaseNPCTroika spawn 0x10298d30) does not see a standing player behind the block -- FVisible slot 201 (0x102b4630, mask 0x2804091) fails on the solid -- and sees him the moment he walks out from behind it into the cone at ~295 units. Look (0x1030ff10, players every 0.15 s) admits him (QuerySeeEntity 0x102b38b0, FInViewCone slot 363 0x102b4540 -> 0x10326750, admission 0x102b4760: standing player -> sight scalar 1.0, stealth.md 'Player target-surface update'); OnLooked 0x1026a2c0 raises SEE_PLAYER 0x5a and, D_HT priority 5 < 11, SEE_HATE 0x43 with UpdateEnemyMemory; ChooseEnemy 0x10279dd0 commits him (NEW_ENEMY 0x54); GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20 step 3 raises SEE_ENEMY 0x46 and fires OnFoundPlayer; SelectIdealState 0x102ad660 case 1 (NEW_ENEMY in IDLE_DISPOSITION's mask) -> COMBAT; GetSchedule 0x102ae920 step 5 -> 0xea SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT. Geometry (Source units): guard on behind_cover (156, 0) facing -X; the player starts at (-176, 0), walks to (-176, 250) (still behind the block: the sight line crosses x = 96 at y = 45) and then along y = 250 to (40, 250); the line clears the block's corner at x ~ 0, 295 units out (inside 0.7 x 440, so no outer band).
